prompt: Complete the function-pointer type, the table lookup and the fold. A table row is `(&str, BinOp)`, and the closure receives it by reference.
explain: `extern "C" fn(...)` is the C-ABI function pointer type. The table is iterated by reference, so `*f` copies the pointer out of the row. Calling `op(acc, x)` then invokes whichever function was passed in.
